text: Which is the furthest Bundibugyo countermeasure milestone reached by 31 December 2026? (Baseline: Oxford Phase I Bundibugyo vaccine trial launched 13 July 2026. WHO therapeutic trial, remdesivir and MBP134, began enrolling patients on 2 July 2026)
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the furthest milestone reached, per WHO, the trial sponsors, or the regulator, as of 31 December 2026. Source: WHO, ICTRP and other trial registries, partner announcements.
